metric_scope: Descriptive canonical single-token E probability over the FULL vocabulary and E-minus-fixed-old-W margin on eight old errors only. Not accepted-variant sums, whole-answer accuracy, new mechanism evidence or confirmation. Six reopened development worlds.

registered_whole_answer_assessment_uncha.scope: Six previously opened development worlds; exploratory diagnosis only. A full natural-head transfer is a comparator, not a mathematical performance bound or proof of entity abstraction. Random control matches only the full-head delta norm, not factor doses.
